CustomField.formula: "Q" & CASE( MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), 1, "4", 2, "4", 3, "4", 4, "1", 5, "1", 6, "1", 7, "2", 8, "2", 9, "2", 10, "3", 11, "3", 12, "3", "0" ) & " " & TEXT( IF( MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) < 4, YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) - 1, YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) ) ) & "-" & RIGHT( TEXT( IF( MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) < 4, YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)), YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) + 1 ) ), 2 )
CustomField.label: Period
